title: Universal finite free embeddings on Noetherian quasi-affine opens
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $V$ an open of $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and $M$ an $\mathcal O_V$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] which is finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. There exist a natural number $r$ and a monomorphism $\alpha:M\to\mathcal O_V^r$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module] such that its categorical cokernel is finite locally free and, for every scheme $Y$ and morphism $g:Y\to V$, the morphism $g^*\alpha$ is monic.

source.place: Tag 0EKP, first dual-surjection construction in (2) to (3), with the structure sheaf ample; denominator clearing gives global generators on a quasi-affine open.

proof.text: The Noetherian open V is quasi-compact. Cover it by finitely many affine principal opens of Spec R on which the dual of M is free. Finite locally free duality makes the dual finite type and quasi-coherent.

Extend each basis section from each such principal open by clearing denominators, using the structure sheaf as the invertible module. On that principal open its defining function is a unit, so the resulting global sections still generate. The finite collection of all these sections therefore gives an epimorphism from a finite free sheaf to the dual of M.

On an affine trivializing neighbourhood the target of this epimorphism is a finite free module. The epimorphism splits. Its kernel is a finitely generated projective summand, hence becomes free after shrinking. Dualize the split sequence and use finite locally free biduality. This yields a monomorphism from M to finite free with finite locally free cokernel. Locally the morphism is a split inclusion; arbitrary pullback preserves this splitting. Use a finite cardinal and ULift to index the finite free sheaf, including the empty and rank-zero cases.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_universally_mono_free
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (V : (Spec (.of R)).Opens) (M : V.toScheme.Modules) [M.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (α : M ⟶ free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))),
      Mono α ∧ (cokernel α).IsFiniteLocallyFree ∧
      ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ V.toScheme), Mono ((Modules.pullback g).map α)
